title: Chapter 183: The Dignity Of The Demon Race
content:
Chapter 183: The Dignity Of The Demon Race

Wu Qing quickly finalized two new Zerg units, solving problems on the battlefield in the underground world, allowing the Zerg to continue harvesting the ghouls without having to exit the underground world early.

On the other side, on the battlefield in the Naga territory, the battle between the Naga army and the Zerg army to jointly attack the demon castle also entered a critical moment.

A large number of dog demons and one-star flame demons in the demon army left the castle and mixed in with the lemure demons. Even if the Naga tribe had a large number of long-range troops to suppress them, they could not stop them from relying on their own strength to quickly rush to the front line. ,.

The fire attack and powerful melee ability of the dog demon, combined with the fireball attack of the one-star flame demon, finally made the Zerg puppies who had been fighting on the front line feel the pressure, and began to suffer a large number of casualties.

Dog demons are like cockroaches, the new army of the Zerg. With powerful fire attacks and strong melee capabilities, it is difficult for Zerg puppies to besiege them.

The flames of the dog demon are very terrifying. Even the flame resistance of the Zerg cannot withstand the continuous burning. The dog demon can spray flames in sheets, making it difficult for Zerg puppies to get close.

Even if the Zerg puppy succeeds in getting close to the dog demon, it will be damaged by the fire and its combat power will be weakened. It is no match for the dog demon with strong melee capabilities.

The fireball launched by the one-star flame demon is also very powerful. Although the Zerg puppy at the center of the explosion may not die, it will definitely be severely disabled and its combat power will be greatly reduced.

Among the Naga army, only the one-star mounted archers of the Yu clan can effectively suppress the dog demons and the one-star fire demons.

However, under the interference and protection of a large number of lemures, it was difficult for them to kill the dog demons and one-star fire demons.

"Fire two more rounds from the siege weapon!"

Seeing this situation, Nagaya gave the order to continue using siege weapons.

After these two rounds of shooting, some of the Naga's siege weapons will be out of ammunition, and the large trebuchets can only project real solid stones.

"Boom boom...!"

The Naga's terrifying siege weapon attack came, and the demon army gathered under the castle fell to the ground on a large scale. Corpses were everywhere, and hot demon blood flowed across the field!

"The trebuchet will smash the castle for me!"

Nagaya continued to order.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Without the goblin clan's special ammunition, the precious trebuchet purchased by the naga clan from the goblin clan was used as an ordinary trebuchet, and began to continuously project boulders towards the demon clan's castle.

The huge stone ball hit the demon castle with a roar. The castle was not very strong in the first place. Under such an attack, the bricks and stones flew everywhere.

The Naga began to smash stones, and the Demons knew that those terrible siege weapons had no ammunition, and more elite troops poured out of the Demons' castle.

The dignity of the demon clan does not allow the enemy to enter the demon clan's castle!

A large number of lemures continued to fill the demon battle formation, and more dog demons and one-star flame demons mixed into the lemures.

Through Host No. 3, Wu Qing saw that the Demon Clan had so many one-star troops, and then he understood how difficult it was for the Naga Clan to hold on. The Demon Clan was much stronger than the Bugbear Clan.

This may also be due to the different methods of improving the strength of the two evil god camps. The luck resources of the demon clan are used to improve the strength of the army, so there are particularly many one-star units in their armies.

The bugbear clan is more about improving the strength of the sacrifices and improving the strength of the army through the blessing of the sacrifices' faith.

Of these two methods, it is not clear who is better or worse. As long as the resources are sufficient, both can increase the military's combat effectiveness to a terrifying level.

The Demon Tribe is somewhat similar to the Zerg Tribe. They blindly pile up resources and improve the hard power of the army without any additional blessings.

After such a long battle, the strength of the Zerg puppies has dropped to less than 200,000. Some of the Naga's high-morale melee troops began to rush to the front line and participate in the battle.

The Naga army is indeed very strong, not to mention the Naga warriors themselves. They are all well-equipped melee masters, and the lemures basically cannot defeat them.

The troops of other races in the Naga army are also very powerful. Their races are still the same. There is not much difference from the Tengu army. The big difference is the training and equipment.

In the Naga army, all the troops participating in the battle are fully equipped and well-trained. All melee troops, no matter what race they are, can fight the lemures equally well depending on their equipment and combat skills. up and down.

At least the Naga melee troops sent to the Zerg puppies are all of this level, and they are all truly elite.

Through Host No. 3, Wu Qing saw the corpses of the demon army piling up on the battlefield, and felt that a large amount of resources were flowing away from his hands.

The strength of the Zerg puppies is no longer enough. More and more Naga troops are participating in the war. Wu Qing feels that if he continues to keep the Explosive Mosquitoes, he might as well take the opportunity to earn more resources. After this battle, he will continue to send out the third batch tomorrow. Reinforcements.

Wu Qing had this idea. Except for the ten three-star explosive mosquitoes, the other Zerg explosive mosquitoes flew down from high altitude and launched a self-destruction attack on the dense demon army.

"Boom boom boom...!"

Fierce explosions continued to sound among the demon army, and large areas of the demon army disappeared into flames.

When Nagaya saw the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes actively attacking the ordinary demon army, she wanted to stop them, but gave up after thinking about it.

She wanted to use these Zerg Explosive Swarms at a critical moment. The Explosive Swarms blew up all the three-star flame demons of the strategic level of the Demon Clan at one time. The performance was too outstanding, which made her feel that it was a bit of a waste to use such valuable troops to deal with ordinary Demon Clan troops.

But she also knew the importance of battlefield sacrifice to the Zerg. The explosion of the Zerg Explosive Swarms did clear a lot of obstacles for the attack of the Naga Clan army. She also carefully discovered that there were still a small number of special Explosive Swarms that did not join the attack, so the Zerg Clan was left to fight on its own.

Nearly 500 Zerg Explosive Swarms were put into the battlefield in a short period of time. The number of demon army troops directly killed was relatively small, but the Zerg biological decomposition liquid splashing everywhere could continue to cause damage to the demon army.

With the cause and effect relationship of these injuries, even if these demon army troops were eventually killed by the Naga army, the system could harvest resources. This was Wu Qing's purpose, everything for resources.

At this point in the battle, in order to prevent the Naga army from entering the castle, the Demon Clan sent out most of the garrisons in the castle and had been fighting a war of attrition with the Naga and Zerg armies.

Because of the Zerg's participation in the war, the strategic arms of the Demon Clan were destroyed instantly. Without this strategic advantage, the Demon Clan suffered heavy losses, with most of its total troops lost.

The Naga Clan had the Zerg Hounds in the front, so the losses were minimal. Now the Naga Clan has an absolute advantage in terms of the strength of the two sides.

Wu Qing could clearly see through the ten three-star explosive mosquitoes flying in the air that the castle, which was originally full of the Demon Clan army, had become very empty.

The Naga Clan seized the opportunity and invested a large number of troops in the front line, fighting side by side with the Zerg Hounds, continuing to expand the front line and accelerating the consumption of the Demon Clan army.

Almost all the Demon Clan troops in the Demon Clan Castle left the city, and a particularly huge dog demon slowly walked out of the castle, with a purple-red flame demon standing on its back.

A team of giant dog demons, a team of flame demons and a team of tall and strong inferior demons accompanied them, and the surrounding Demon Clan troops consciously made way.

The purple-red flame demon stood on the back of the tall dog demon, and as soon as it left the city, it set its sights on the position of Naga and Host No. 3.

A large fireball with purple in red flew out of its hand and flew quickly towards Naga's position.

Naga remained calm, picked up the longbow, and a golden light flashed all over her body. A golden arrow shot out and hit the fireball like lightning.

"Boom...!"

The purple-red fireball and the golden arrow collided, causing a huge explosion in the air, and the armies of both sides who were fighting below were affected.

"The energy arrow is well used! The cultivation method of this world is also unique!"

It was the first time that Wu Qing saw someone in this world who could add powerful energy to the arrow. This ability was a skill that his former archers would have when their strength reached a certain level.

Without the blessing of energy, the arrow driven by the kinetic energy generated by the bow and arrow could not hit the beasts of that world at all.

From this arrow, it can be seen that Naga is very strong. She should be the strongest person Wu Qing has ever seen in this world.

"Elder, has the entire demon tribe left the city?"

Wu Qing asked Naga through host No. 3.

After shooting the arrow just now, Naga remained calm, and the fire demon who was suspected to be the leader of the demon tribe did not provoke again.

"Don't look at the rough appearance of the demon tribe, they are very face-saving!"

"They will not let us enter the castle unless we fight to the last moment!"

Naga responded.

"Will they have a backup plan in the castle?"

Wu Qing asked again.

"Probably not. The demon tribe is not like the bear goblin tribe. They don't have so many tricks!"

Naga stared at the team of strong enemies and watched them enter the square formation of the demon army.

"Then I will try to blow them up. If successful, it will save a lot of trouble!"

Wu Qing observed the strong team of the demon tribe and felt that the leading fire demon and the dog demon under it were at least four-star in strength.

The accompanying dog demons, flame demons and inferior demons should all be two-star strength. With the addition of such a force, the demon army has greatly increased its combat power.

The Naga army must pay a heavy price to destroy them.

"The other party is on guard, you may not be able to blow them up!"

Naga looked up at Host No. 3. She knew that the leader of the Zerg would not speak casually.

She had some expectations for the Zerg in her heart. After only a short time together, the Zerg has created many miracles.

If the Zerg can really kill the most difficult person in the demon army, the Naga tribe will really make a big profit in this battle. The advantage of this battle alone is enough to reverse the situation in the entire Naga territory!
